$comment: The render context for templates/display-manager/regreet.css.j2. ZERO variables: the stylesheet is a fixed GTK4 sheet, and this schema says so with an empty `required` and an empty `properties` map — an empty `required` is only legal here because the template reads nothing, which `make validate-templates` derives from the body rather than trusting this file.
title: display-manager/regreet.css.j2 — render context
description: No render context: the regreet stylesheet carries no Jinja expressions. The `.j2` suffix is kept because the consumer renders it through the template module (idempotent, atomic, mode-controlled), not because it interpolates.

x-render-contract.why_a_schema_for_a_variable_free_templat: `additionalProperties: false` with no properties is a real assertion: a `{{ }}` added later fails `make validate-templates` until a property (and a required/optional placement) is declared. The pair is what makes the empty contract checkable rather than absent.
x-render-contract.unrendered_at_v040: Retained for the greetd+regreet fallback path (spine AD-9).
